game_title: Boolean Circuit – Crater Lake Edge Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the smelter.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the smelter. Each round, lava imps strike the smelter, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the smelter from lava imps in Crater Lake Edge: keep the power_on meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: power_on drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Crater Lake Edge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while power_on > 0.
